description: Gridbook trellis (TCQ) container on GB10 sm_121: TCQ_E2M1_R256 and TCQ_E4M3_R256 dense lanes decoded via Gridbook plugin pinned in prismaquant/gridbook_runtime/gridbook_runtime_pin.json (0.9.1, 227420f). Activation contracts are e2m1_group16_ue4m3_static (W4A4) and fp8_per_token_dynamic (W8A8). Both lanes are opt-in behind GRIDBOOK_TRELLIS_* flags; the flags are artifact metadata, not folklore. The four cells on sm_121 are device_qualified backed_with_serve_flag at rungs 512 and 1152 respectively; candidate rungs outside that set and routed_moe structure are unbacked serving gaps (WO-D).

gates.description: Fresh exact-pinned Gridbook container, TP=1, fp8 KV, speculative decode off, --enforce-eager, then two identical non-empty greedy completions over the OpenAI endpoint. Fills the eager load/generation slot.

A second fresh exact-pinned Gridbook container with --enforce-eager absent, followed by the same endpoint proof and a distinct server-side fingerprint. Eager success cannot stand in for CUDA-graph load/capture/generation success.
Unchanged from the native lane: same validator, endpoint, and thresholds. Endpoint-agnostic ship gate.

Served KL-vs-BF16 in the plugin serving env. Its BF16 teacher is produced first by tools/build_streamed_full_kl_teacher.py --wikitext-inputs <gold-inputs.json>. Match extension residency across A/B arms: loading a CUDA extension shifts allocator addresses and moves confident-KL by up to 17%.
Direct WikiText PPL on the served trellis artifact using the exact CPU-materialized, value-closed offline token payload.

kl_evaluator.note: Resident held-out KL over Pareto assignments, production-cache rendered; feeds select_validated_frontier. Returns (mean, per_sequence, stats) with kl_p95/kl_p99/kl_max/nll_p99. For trellis this is the W*A16 screen today (A-side unpriced); the lane's served contract is W4A4/W8A8 and the A-side must be priced before promotion (WO-D D3 leg2).

served_activation_quantization.rationale: DERIVED from Gridbook lanes trellis_e2m1_lane.py and trellis_e4m3_lane.py. E2M1: group-16 ue4m3 block plane * e2m1 codes plus global_scale_real, lane declares ACTIVATION_CONTRACT = e2m1_group16_ue4m3_static and quantizes activations to E2M1 group16 via native_fp4_quant before _scaled_mm (W4A4). E4M3: per-row fp32 scale + e4m3 codes, lane declares ACTIVATION_CONTRACT = fp8_per_token_dynamic and quantizes activations per token to E4M3 via native_fp8_quant before _scaled_mm (W8A8). Both are Blackwell-only and opt-in behind GRIDBOOK_TRELLIS_* flags with residency mode.

notes: Four trellis cells on sm_121 (device_qualified, backed_with_serve_flag): TCQ_E2M1_R256@512 decode/batch (e2m1_group16_ue4m3_static) and TCQ_E4M3_R256@1152 decode/batch (fp8_per_token_dynamic), each requiring GRIDBOOK_TRELLIS_E2M1/E4M3=1 plus GRIDBOOK_TRELLIS_*_MODE=resident|streamed. Candidate rungs outside [512] and [1152] and any routed_moe structure are unbacked gaps (WO-D).
Single-GPU only: the pinned Gridbook contract has no qualified TP path for trellis (max_world_size 1, trellis_tensor_parallel_world_size=1).

Fused serving units (qkv_proj, gate_up_proj per packed_modules_mapping order) are one trellis wire per merged module, not per-role (WO-C correction, gridbook/config.py::_build_trellis_method at 227420f).
Serve script passes exact trellis flags through to the container and binds --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 with -p 8000:8000 (loopback bind is unreachable from LAN test host).
